description: This file defines a custom adapter for a WearableRecyclerView in an Android Wear OS application. It manages the display of a list of text items, binds click events to notify a controller about item selection, and holds a ViewHolder class for recycling views.

classes.name: CustomRecyclerAdapter
classes.description: A RecyclerView adapter for managing and displaying a list of string data on Android Wear devices, with a nested ViewHolder class.

classes.name: ViewHolder
classes.description: Holds references to the item view components used in each list item, primarily a TextView.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates and initializes the ViewHolder for each list item.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds data to the view components and sets click listener for each item.

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of items in the dataset.
